name: Podium rank
oneLiner: three glass steps rise off a lit floor with their rank numerals and scores counting up as they grow; the entries drop onto them third, second, then first, and the winning step floods with the accent under a beam of light while the camera lifts toward it
say: when the speaker names a top three or says what came first ('third place, second, and the winner was...'): cut in on the ranking, the winner drops onto the top step on the word that names it
